title: ArchMaker Diagnostic (v0)
description: Typed, localized result of a validation stage. Codes come from the canonical AM-* catalog in docs/04-interfaces/errors-events.md. Severity and blocking are canonical and consistent: error is always blocking, warning/info never are. Diagnostic lists have a stable order. Contract state: v0.
$comment: Contract v0 (phase R6, AUD-014). Shared $defs live in common.schema.json. Unknown fields rejected except the documented params map.

blocking.description: Whether the diagnostic blocks manifest construction. Canonical: error => true; warning/info => false.

params.description: Open parameter map for message interpolation. Documented open map required by the domain; values are scalars only.

source.description: Component that emitted the diagnostic, e.g. archmaker-resolver.

ruleId.description: Rule that produced the diagnostic, when applicable.

emittedAt.description: Ephemeral emission timestamp; excluded from the canonical hash payload.

diagnosticSortKey.description: Stable sort keys for diagnostic collections, applied in order: path, then code, then source (UTF-16 comparison).

diagnosticList.description: Ordered diagnostic collection. Producers MUST emit it sorted by (path, code, source) so the same input yields byte-identical output (NFR-DET-001).
